vision: Real-time, high-accuracy, industrial-grade reel warehouse management with native digital twin and mission-driven optimization.

selected_architecture.name: Phased architecture with digital twin core
selected_architecture.description: Phase 1 UWB pilot, phase 2 hybrid expansion, phase 3 autonomous logistics integration.

software: Mission Manager and AI Coordinator connectors

integration.INGEPRO: Bidirectional REST/event integration for reel lifecycle and location state.
integration.MES: Event bridge for production orders, reel consumption, and track assignments.
integration.digital_twin: Unified graph/twin model for live location, history, and simulation replay.

roadmap: Phase 1 (0-3 months): Site survey, UWB pilot zone, INGEPRO read integration.
Phase 2 (4-8 months): Full warehouse rollout, MES write-back, dashboard hardening.
Phase 3 (9-14 months): Hybrid redundancy layer, autonomous logistics integration API.
Phase 4 (15-18 months): AI optimization loop and cross-plant scaling blueprint.
expected_competitive_advantages: High-accuracy RTLS tuned for corrugated reel flow
Digital twin continuity from operations to planning
Mission-oriented architecture ready for AI Coordinator governance
